title: Irish Cod Gratin
description: A light and flaky cod dish topped with a creamy gratin, inspired by Irish cuisine. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the cod and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through.
Transfer the cod to the prepared baking sheet.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter. Add the cubed bread and cook until lightly toasted.
In a separate bowl, mix the grated cheese and sliced onion.
Top each cod fillet with the toasted bread mixture.
Transfer the baking sheet to the oven and bake for 5-7 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately.
